data.name: Satish
data.gender_notes: Satish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of truth; ruler of the true
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sat, 'truth', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of truth'. Its root is Sanskrit sat + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name. Satish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of truth; ruler of the true”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Satish expresses “Lord of truth; ruler of the true”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit sat, 'truth', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of truth'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satish total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
